setup: A triangle has two sides of length $[[a]]$ and $[[b]]$ with an included angle of $[[angle]]^{\circ}$.

steps.say: Two sides and the angle between them are enough because that angle fixes the height: $A = \tfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$, half the product of the two sides times the sine of the included angle.
So the area is $\tfrac{1}{2} \cdot [[a]] \cdot [[b]] \cdot [[sin_val]]$, which is [[value]].
The third side and the other two angles never enter, which is what makes this the shortest route when a triangle is described by two sides and the angle between them.
